Title: Log Analytics solutions and views will soon drill in to the new Logs UX

Body.Content:
Three months ago, we announced the new Azure Monitor Logs UX. The new UX started as a preview, and has since become the main experience for searching and analyzing Azure Monitor logs.

Until now, clicking charts and tables in Log Analytics solutions and views has opened the classic log search page. Starting in early January, solutions and views will open the new Logs UX instead, offering an improved query editor and a full schema view.

 

 

The classic log search page is currently still available through the Log Analytics menu item Logs (classic).

Let us know what you think. Write us at lafeedback@microsoft.com, or post in our community space.
